title: Madoka Magica: Walpurgisnacht
alt: A giant witch hangs head down in a storm that turns round her. She has a wide blue dress with rows of white frills, long white sleeves, a round white face with no eyes and a red laughing mouth full of teeth, a two-horned striped cap, and great gear wheels above her. Dark shapes of girls dance in the air near her, and pieces of buildings float. A city burns below. A girl with long black hair, a round shield and a pistol stands on a broken roof and looks up at her.
summary: A painting of Homura and Walpurgisnacht from Puella Magi Madoka Magica in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is Walpurgisnacht, from Puella Magi Madoka Magica, an anime by Shaft. She is the strongest witch. She hangs head down over Mitakihara, laughs, and lifts the city into the air.
Homura Akemi stands on a roof and looks up at her. Homura has turned time back again and again to save Madoka, and each time she has met this night. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
